items.claim: `onAddThumb` on an endless slider gets the track position instead of the value
A thumb added under `constraint: 'ordered'` is put last, out of order
A region drag and a thumb drag can run at once, each writing its own snapshot
`useBoxes` never measures an element that replaces another while the thumb count stays the same
`endless="min"` under a log `scale` throws during render
items.note: Under a `scale`, the end stop now sits a twentieth of the track past the end. This also moves the `endless="max"` stop on a log track, which used to sit one step past max, too close to see or press.

items.claim: Shift-all and region drags ignore `snap: 'strict'` and the step grid
items.note: This needed a behavior call, so I made one and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`, replacing the Open entry. Under strict, each thumb moves the same number of stops, as many as the pointer crossed, so the thumbs stay on stops but may not keep their gap. Otherwise each thumb lands on the `step` grid.

items.claim: A key that cannot move a thumb still commits an edit
items.note: `docs/conventions.md` already rules this, so I retired the Open entry in `docs/unruled.md`. The key is still kept from the page. One stops test that expected the old no-op `onInput` now expects none.

items.claim: On an endless slider whose range is not a whole number of steps, a drag cannot reach the finite end
A thumb's `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax` ignore its own `bounds` and its ordered neighbors
Escape after a thumb drag that came back to its start sends no `onCancel`, while a region drag does
An end stop's label is pulled off center when that stop is not at the track's end
